info.name: Reaya+ API
info.description:
Reaya+ backend API. Responses use `{ data, meta? }`; errors use `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`. Messages are Arabic (`Accept-Language: ar`).

Set `baseUrl`, then call "Verify OTP" (or "Refresh") and paste `access_token` into the `accessToken` variable.
